name: Art Academy of Latvia
note: Latvia's national art academy, with portfolio-based entry. Its English pages (September 2026) describe exchange study and a joint master's in Service Design and Innovations, and no English-taught bachelor's degree for a degree-seeking student.
admissionsUrlNote: Checked 2026-09-23. The Art Academy publishes no standing admissions page. The URL previously recorded here — lma.lv/en/admission — is a soft 404, and the cycle page the site itself used, /en/studies/admission-2023-2, has been taken down rather than renewed. Each year's rules are issued instead as Latvian-language PDFs under lma.lv/data/, and applications are taken through the portal at apply.lma.lv. Worth knowing before applying: the entrance examinations are conducted in Latvian.
summary: Riga's national art academy: bachelor's degrees run in Latvian, and English is used only for exchange students and one joint master's.

handoff.label: Study options: exchange and joint master's

ib.text: No English-taught bachelor's degree. The main language of instruction is Latvian, so an IB Diploma alone does not open a degree place; English supervision is for exchange students.

notes: Incoming study in English is exchange study (Erasmus+ and similar) plus the joint master's in Service Design and Innovations; no bachelor's degree is offered in English.
